data.name: Najmiyah
data.gender_notes: Najmiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Najmiyah is a celestial name that symbolizes guidance and direction, inspired by the stars in the sky. The name Najmiyah carries the meaning “Star of the sky” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najmiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody star of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the stars represent guidance and direction, as mentioned in the Quran (16:16).
data.etymology: Najmiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Star of the sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najmiyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نجمية
in_arabic.meaning: نجم النجومية تعني الشخصية المضيئة والمشرقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: النجمية هي كلمة تعبر عن الشخصية التي تتميز بالضوء والاشعاع، مشتقة من النجم الذي يضيء في السماء، وترمز إلى الهداية والإرشاد. في القرآن الكريم، يوصف الله تعالى بالنجم المضيء الذي يهدي الناس إلى الطريق الصحيح. اسم نجمية يعكس هذه المعاني الروحية والدلالات الإلهية، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل قيمة دينية وروحية عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: نجمیہ
in_urdu.meaning: نجمیہ کا مطلب ہے روشن اور چمکتی ہوئی شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نجمیہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'نجم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ستارہ۔ یہ نام روشن اور مضیاء شخصیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، ستاروں کو 하늘 کے روشن اور رہبری کرنے والے عناصر کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ لہذا، نام نجمیہ روحانی روشنی، رہبری اور تحریک کی معانی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز انتخاب ہے جو ان کی ثقافتی اور اسلامی ورثے سے جڑا ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नजमीया
in_hindi.meaning: नजमीया का अर्थ है चमकती और प्रकाशमान व्यक्तित्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: नजमीया एक अरबी नाम है जो 'नजम' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है तारा। यह नाम चमकते और प्रकाशमान व्यक्तित्व को दर्शाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, तारों को आकाश के उज्ज्वल और मार्गदर्शक तत्वों के रूप में देखा जाता है। इसलिए, नाम नजमीया आध्यात्मिक प्रकाश, मार्गदर्शन और प्रेरणा के अर्थों को प्रकट करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण चयन है जो उनकी सांस्कृतिक और इस्लामी विरासत से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: نجميہ
in_pashto.meaning: نجميہ د روښانه او منور شخصیت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: نجميہ د عربي نوم دی چې د 'نجم' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ستوري وي. دا نوم د روښانه او منور شخصیت دلالت کوي. په اسلامي دود کې، ستوري د اسمان د روښانه او هدايت ورکوونکو عناصرو په توګه ليدل کيږي. نو ځکه، نوم نجميہ روحاني روښانتیا، هدايت او الهام معنا څرګندوي. د افغان او پښتنو په دود کې، دا نوم يو ښکلی او معنی لرونکی انتخاب دی چې د هغوی کلتوري او اسلامي ميراث سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Najmiyah
in_english.meaning: Najmiyah means shining and radiant personality
in_english.long_meaning: Najmiyah is an Arabic name derived from 'najm', meaning star. The name signifies a shining and radiant personality. In Islamic tradition, stars are seen as celestial guides and symbols of divine light. The Quran references stars as signs and guidance in the universe (Quran 6:97, 16:16). Najmiyah embodies spiritual illumination, guidance, and inspiration. Historically, the name has been used across Muslim cultures, symbolizing hope, direction, and positive attributes. In modern times, Najmiyah remains a popular choice for parents seeking a name with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

data.cultural_impact: Najmiyah carries an evocative and culturally rich meaning in the Islamic tradition. The name is derived from the Arabic word "najm," which translates to "star" in English. The name Najmiyah pertains to the idea of being guided by a shining star, and this connotation is deeply embedded in Islamic culture and tradition, given the emphasis on constellations and celestial navigation throughout Islamic history. The naming of a child as Najmiyah reflects a hope for a life filled with guidance, wisdom, and an unwavering sense of direction.
data.spiritual_significance: Najmiyah holds profound spiritual significance in the Islamic worldview. The Arabic Quranic verse, "Guide us to the straight path"" (1:6), echoes the importance of seeking guidance from Allah SWT (God). The name Najmiyah personifies this spiritual journey, symbolizing an individual reaching for the divine light and being guided along the path of righteousness throughout their life. In Sufism, the mystical interpretation of Islam, Najmiyah can be seen as the guiding influence from the divine realm, illuminating the seeker's heart and soul and leading them towards a deeper connection with Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Star of the sky" symbolizes Najmiyah is a celestial name that symbolizes guidance and direction, inspired by the stars in the sky.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Najmiyah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of star of the sky.
